title: BEN (NASDAQ: BNAI) Signs Definitive Agreement to Acquire Cataneo GmbH, a Global Media Infrastructure Leader, in a Debt-Free $19.5 Million Transaction
summary: BEN’s commercial-ready AI solutions deliver human-like responses using natural language, combined with the ability to remember customer details and problem solve in real-time on mobile devices, computers and stand-alone kiosks.
body_markdown:
**About Brand Engagement Network, Inc.** Brand Engagement Network, Inc. (NASDAQ: BNAI) builds secure, enterprise-grade artificial intelligence for the engagement layer of AI, between companies and consumers, where people interact with systems and real-world outcomes are driven. Powered by its proprietary Engagement Language Model (ELM™), BEN’s technology delivers conversational AI that connects human intent to organizational data, workflows, and actions inside closed-loop, privacy-protective, governed environments. Trusted by organizations in regulated and high-stakes industries, BEN brings AI into operational settings where engagement, accountability, and results matter.


For more information, visit[www.brandengagementnetwork.com](http://www.brandengagementnetwork.com/) .
